situation: 我叫李想，2024年本科毕业，毕设《共享单车调度优化》是王老师指导的，我也在他课题组做过数据清洗。现在在物流公司做数据分析，想请他写推荐信申请港大交通工程MPhil，12月1日截止。毕业两年一直没怎么联系过他。
reply: 王老师您好，我是2024届的李想，毕设《共享单车调度优化》是您指导的。好久没向您汇报，我现在在一家物流公司做数据分析。我在申请港大交通工程MPhil，12月1日截止，想请您帮我写一封推荐信，不知是否方便？我可以先整理一份草稿和简历给您参考，重点是毕设的调度模型和我在课题组做的数据清洗。如果您最近太忙，完全理解。
note: 隔了很久再联系，先提醒对方你是谁、做过什么，再提请求和截止日期。

situation: Asked my old charge nurse Chris to be a phone reference for an ICU job. We covered night shifts together and he saw me handle the new charting system rollout. He said 'I'm not sure I'm the best person, we only overlapped 8 months.'
reply: That's fair, 8 months isn't long. The two things I'd most like them to hear about are the night shifts we covered together and how I handled the new charting system rollout, which you saw firsthand. Would it help if I sent you those two points and the call details? If it still doesn't feel right, I'll ask someone else, no problem.
note: Offer the bullets once. If he still hesitates, move to the next name the same day.

situation: Moving to Leeds in December. The new letting agent, Harlow Homes, wants a reference from my current landlord, Mr Patel, by Friday 9 October; it's a short email form. I've paid on time for 3 years. Texting him.
reply: Hi Mr Patel, I'm moving to Leeds in December and the new letting agent, Harlow Homes, has asked for a landlord reference by Friday 9 October. Would you be willing to give one? It's a short email form, mainly confirming three years of on-time rent and the flat's condition. If this week is bad for you, let me know and I'll ask them for more time.

situation: My old manager at Brightline, Omar, said yes to being a reference for a Senior UX Researcher role at Kestrel Health. Hannah Cho (hannah.cho@example.com) will email him to set up a 15-minute call between Mon 5 and Fri 9 October. I'd like him to mention our 2024 patient portal study, the research repository I set up, and my work with engineering on the checkout redesign.
reply: Thank you, Omar, that means a lot. Here's everything in one place: the role is Senior UX Researcher at Kestrel Health, and Hannah Cho, hannah.cho@example.com, will email you to set up a 15-minute call sometime between Monday 5 and Friday 9 October. If it helps, the three things they care most about are the patient portal study we ran in 2024, the research repository I set up, and how I worked with engineering on the checkout redesign. I'll let you know how it goes.
note: After a yes, one message with who, when, the role and the points to mention, so he never has to dig back through the thread.

situation: I'm Ana, a freelance bookkeeper. My client Diane, who owns Harbourside Physio, told me last month that I'd saved her hours every week. I'm redoing my website and want a short quote from her with her name and clinic.
reply: Hi Diane, I'm updating my website this month and a line from you would carry a lot of weight with other clinic owners. Something like: "Since Ana took over our books, I save hours every week." Feel free to rewrite it completely, or tell me it's not something you'd like to do. Would you be okay with me using your name and Harbourside Physio alongside it? Any time before Friday 16 October would be perfect.
note: Write the quote for her to edit, ask separately about using her name, and put the deadline in the first message.

situation: Tengo 17 años y busco mi primer trabajo, de fines de semana en la Librería Nápoles; me piden una referencia y seguramente la contacten antes del viernes 9 de octubre. Llevo dos años de voluntaria los sábados en el banco de alimentos del barrio, donde coordiné el reparto de Navidad. Quiero pedírsela a la coordinadora, Marta.
reply: Hola Marta, estoy buscando mi primer trabajo, los fines de semana en la Librería Nápoles, y me piden una referencia. Como nunca he trabajado, eres quien mejor conoce cómo trabajo, por estos dos años de sábados en el banco de alimentos. ¿Te parece bien que dé tu nombre y tu correo? Seguramente te contacten antes del viernes 9 de octubre. Si quieres, te paso la oferta y un par de cosas que podrías mencionar, como que coordiné el reparto de Navidad. Y si no te viene bien, lo entiendo perfectamente.
note: Sin historial laboral, el voluntariado cuenta: di por qué ella, la fecha, ofrécele material para que le sea fácil y deja una salida sin culpa.

situation: I asked my old head of department, Mrs. Okonkwo, to be a reference for a teaching job at Riverside Academy. I emailed her on Sept 15 and followed up on Sept 22. Nothing. The application closes Friday Oct 9, and my placement mentor, Mr. Hale, would probably say yes.
reply: Hi Mrs. Okonkwo, no worries at all if my note got buried. I've asked someone else for this one, so there's nothing you need to do. I'd still love to catch up sometime, and I hope all is well at school.
note: After two unanswered messages, treat it as a no: ask Mr. Hale today and send one line that closes the ask without guilt.

situation: Mein früherer Chef, Herr Wagner, war letzte Woche meine Referenz bei Hausmann Logistik. Heute habe ich die Zusage als Teamleiter Disposition bekommen, Start am 1. November. Die Personalerin, Frau Berger, meinte, er habe sehr konkret über unsere Umstellung der Tourenplanung gesprochen. Ich will mich bei ihm bedanken.
reply: Hallo Herr Wagner, ich wollte Ihnen gleich Bescheid geben: Ich habe die Stelle als Teamleiter Disposition bei Hausmann Logistik bekommen und fange am 1. November an. Frau Berger hat erzählt, wie konkret Sie über die Umstellung der Tourenplanung gesprochen haben, und das hat offenbar viel ausgemacht. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich die Zeit genommen haben. Wenn ich mich einmal revanchieren kann, sagen Sie einfach Bescheid.
note: Noch am selben Tag Bescheid geben und das eine nennen, was geholfen hat. Das bringt das nächste Ja.

situation: 前领导周总答应给我写推荐信了，我申请新加坡国立大学的MBA，10月20号截止，学校10月8日左右会把提交链接发到他邮箱。他回我说“你先起个草稿，我改改再提交”。草稿写了我牵头的2024年华南仓储系统切换、带新人小组把错单率从3%降到0.8%、跨部门协调，想和简历一次发给他。
reply: 周总，太感谢您了！材料都在这里：附件一是推荐信草稿，附件二是我的简历。学校会在10月8日左右把提交链接直接发到您的邮箱，截止日期是10月20日。草稿主要写了三件事：2024年华南仓储系统切换我牵头的部分、带新人小组把错单率从3%降到0.8%、以及跨部门协调的经验。您随便改、随便删，语气按您平时的习惯来就好。结果出来我第一时间告诉您。
note: 对方答应后，草稿、截止日期、谁会联系他一次发齐，并说明可以随便改，让这件事变成十分钟的活。

situation: I asked my former team lead Rachel to be a reference for a data engineering job at Plover. She replied that she doesn't feel she saw enough of my work, since she left three months after I joined, and suggested I ask someone else. I don't want to make it awkward.
reply: Understood, and thank you for telling me straight, Rachel. That's genuinely helpful, and I'll ask someone else. Hope the new role is treating you well.
note: A no gets one line of thanks, no 'why', and the next name gets asked the same day.

situation: 我在悄悄看机会，一家新公司已经到背调阶段，要一位现同事下周接个15分钟左右的电话。想请隔壁组的赵姐帮忙，我们一起做过去年的会员系统，她看到过我负责数据迁移、跟产品组协作和赶工时排优先级。我还没跟领导说在找工作。
reply: 赵姐，想请你帮个忙：我在看外面的一个机会，已经到背调阶段，对方需要一位现在的同事接个电话，大概15分钟，下周内都可以。我们一起做过去年的会员系统，对方可能会问三点：我负责的数据迁移、跟产品组的协作、项目赶工时我怎么排优先级。这事我还没跟领导说，麻烦先帮我保密。如果你觉得为难，完全没关系，我再找别人。
note: 在职背调：一次说清要做什么、多长时间、会被问什么，保密的请求说在明处，出口要真心。

situation: I'm in the final round for an engineering manager role at Tallyfield; they want a 15-minute call, likely 5 to 9 October, with someone I managed. Lena reported to me for two years at Corvo before I left in March; she's now a senior engineer there. We rebuilt the on-call rotation together, I ran weekly 1:1s with her and supported her move to senior.
reply: Hi Lena, I hope things are going well at Corvo. I'm in the final round for an engineering manager role at Tallyfield, and they've asked for a reference from someone I managed. Would you be open to being that person? It would be one 15-minute call, likely between 5 and 9 October. If you say yes, the things they care most about are how I ran our 1:1s, the on-call rotation we rebuilt, and how I supported your move to senior. Please feel free to say no; I know it's different being asked by a former manager, and it won't change anything between us.
note: Asking someone you used to manage: make the out extra explicit, because the old power gap can make a no feel harder to say.

situation: I worked alongside Kofi on the same analytics team for three years, and we built the churn dashboard together; he left in June and we still get on well. I've started job hunting and want a LinkedIn recommendation from him, since my manager there is hard to reach.
reply: Hi Kofi, hope all's well since you left! I've started looking for my next role and I'm updating my LinkedIn, and a short recommendation from you would carry a lot of weight, since we built the churn dashboard together. Three or four sentences is plenty. If it helps, I can send a draft you can edit or throw out. Any time before 16 October would be perfect, and if the timing's bad, no problem at all.
note: A peer can speak to how you work day to day; offer the draft, but only send it once he says yes.

situation: 我老公调到成都工作，我年底要跟过去，已经提前跟领导孙总说了，他很支持，说有需要随时找他。现在成都一家公司的采购主管岗位到了背调环节，要现任上级做证明人，HR下周联系。上半年我做了供应商整合、带了两个新人，年中盘点零差错。
reply: 孙总，上次跟您说了去成都的事，谢谢您这么支持。现在成都那家公司的采购主管岗位到了背调环节，想请您做我的证明人，他们的HR下周会给您打个电话。方便的话可以提三件事：上半年的供应商整合、我带的两个新人，以及年中盘点零差错。您下周要是太忙，跟我说一声，我请他们改个时间；不方便的话也完全没关系。
note: 现任上级已经知道你要走、也表过态时，可以直接请；谁联系、多长时间、会问什么一次说清。

situation: I was laid off from Harwick Media in the August cuts, along with half the marketing team. My manager, Priya, fought to keep me and said to use her as a reference anytime; she saw me run the newsletter relaunch and manage the freelancer budget. I'm now in the final round for a content lead role at Sellwood and they want to call two references between Monday 5 and Friday 9 October.
reply: Hi Priya, I hope you're doing okay after everything at Harwick. I'm in the final round for a content lead role at Sellwood, and they'd like to call two references between Monday 5 and Friday 9 October. You kindly offered in August, so I wanted to check you're still happy to be one before I pass on your details. If it helps, the things they care most about are the newsletter relaunch, the freelancer budget I managed, and, if they ask, that my role was cut in the restructure rather than for performance. If the timing's bad, no problem at all.
note: An old 'anytime' still needs a fresh ask with the dates; after a layoff, a reference who can confirm why you left is worth a bullet.

situation: I'm applying for a funded research assistant post at Halden University that closes Monday Oct 5, and I only found out today that it needs a written reference. My dissertation supervisor, Dr. Mensah, supervised my dissertation on flood-risk mapping last year, including the Cumbria fieldwork, and we're on good terms. I know the notice is terrible.
reply: Hi Dr. Mensah, I'm applying for a funded research assistant post at Halden University, and I only found out today that it needs a written reference by Monday 5 October. I know that's very short notice, and I'm sorry to land it on you. Would you be willing to write one? To make it quick, I can send a draft tonight covering my dissertation on flood-risk mapping and the Cumbria fieldwork, plus the upload link. If this week doesn't work, no problem at all, and I'll ask someone else.
note: Short notice: own it once, put the deadline up front, and offer the draft so the ask shrinks to an edit.

situation: 我叫林溪，上学期选过陈老师的《计量经济学》，考了94分，期末论文写的是最低工资对就业的影响。现在申请学校的海外交换项目，需要两封推荐信，11月10日截止，第二封想请她写。我只上过她一门课，课下没什么交流。
reply: 陈老师您好，我是上学期选修您《计量经济学》的林溪。我在申请学校的海外交换项目，需要两封推荐信，11月10日截止，想请问您是否方便为我写一封？您主要是通过这门课了解我，所以只写课程表现就足够了：期末94分，以及期末论文研究最低工资对就业的影响。我可以把成绩单和论文一起发给您参考。如果您觉得了解不够、不方便写，完全理解，我再请其他老师。
note: 对方只教过你一门课时，把请求限定在他亲眼看到的部分，对方写得出，也更容易答应。

situation: 我叫周宁，去年在一家外企市场部实习，主管是陈姐，她带我做了公众号改版，三个月粉丝涨了40%。现在我申请新加坡一家公司的市场专员岗，对方要一封英文推荐信，10月16日（周五）前发到他们HR邮箱。我和陈姐半年没联系了。
reply: 陈姐好，好久没联系，最近还好吗？我是去年在市场部实习的周宁，公众号改版是您带着我做的。我现在申请新加坡一家公司的市场专员岗位，对方需要一封英文推荐信，10月16日（周五）前发到他们HR的邮箱，想问您是否愿意帮我写？方便的话，我先拟一份英文草稿，重点写公众号改版和三个月粉丝涨了40%，您改改就能用。时间不合适也完全没关系。
note: 要英文推荐信时主动提出写英文草稿，把对方的工作量缩成“改一改”；截止日期放在第一条消息里。

situation: Fui babá do Theo, de 3 anos, durante um ano e meio, até a família da Renata se mudar para Porto Alegre em julho. Eu cuidava das refeições, das sonecas e levava ele na escolinha todo dia. Agora estou me candidatando para cuidar de gêmeos em São Paulo, e a família pediu uma referência por telefone até sexta, 9 de outubro.
reply: Oi, Renata! Espero que vocês estejam se adaptando bem em Porto Alegre, manda um beijo pro Theo. Estou me candidatando para cuidar de gêmeos aqui em São Paulo, e a família pediu uma referência por telefone até sexta, 9 de outubro. Você toparia ser essa referência? Seria uma ligação rápida, e se ajudar, os pontos que mais contam são as refeições, as sonecas e levar o Theo na escolinha todo dia. Se não for um bom momento, sem problema nenhum.
note: Prazo na primeira mensagem e os pontos concretos à mão; se ela topar, mande o nome e o telefone da família numa mensagem só.

situation: Two years ago I left my receptionist job at Pinecrest Dental with only one week's notice because my mum needed surgery, and I know it left my manager, Dr. Hughes, short-staffed. I'm now applying for a practice manager role at another clinic and they want a reference by Monday 12 October. While I was there I set up the online booking system and cut no-shows from about 15% to 6%.
reply: Hi Dr. Hughes, I hope things are good at Pinecrest. I know I left at short notice two years ago, when my mum needed surgery, and I'm sorry it left you short-staffed. I'm now applying for a practice manager role, and they've asked for a reference by Monday 12 October. Would you be willing to be one? If it helps, the thing they care most about is the online booking system I set up, which cut no-shows from about 15% to 6%. If you'd rather not, I completely understand.
note: Name the rough exit once, plainly, before the ask; skipping over it makes a yes harder, and a long apology makes it about you.

situation: Professor Lindqvist agreed on 14 September to write a letter for my application to the MA in Urban Design at Norrvik University. The portal still shows her letter as 'not received' and the deadline is Monday 5 October. The portal lets me resend her the upload link.
reply: Hi Professor Lindqvist, thank you again for agreeing to write my letter for the Norrvik MA in Urban Design. The portal still shows it as not received, and the deadline is Monday 5 October, so I've just resent the upload link in case the first one got lost. If a short draft or my personal statement would make it quicker, I can send either today. Thank you for doing this.
note: A yes with a missed step needs one practical nudge that removes friction, not a second request.

situation: I've freelanced for five years and I'm applying for an in-house brand manager job at Tessel. They want a reference from someone I've reported to, and I've never had a boss. My longest client is Grace Liu, marketing director at Oakfield Tea, who I've worked with for three years; I rebranded their packaging in 2024 and online sales rose 30%. Tessel will call references between Monday 12 and Friday 16 October.
reply: Hi Grace, I have a slightly unusual ask. I'm applying for an in-house brand manager role at Tessel, and they want a reference from someone I've reported to. After three years working together you're the closest thing I have to a manager, so would you be willing to take a short call from them between Monday 12 and Friday 16 October? If it helps, the thing they'll care most about is the 2024 packaging rebrand and the 30% rise in online sales. I know it's an odd thing to ask a client, so if it doesn't feel right, no problem at all.
note: A freelancer's client can stand in for a manager; say plainly why you're asking her and make the no easy, since the job would change your work together.

situation: 我叫赵敏，做了八年全职妈妈，现在应聘社区服务中心的项目助理，需要一位推荐人，对方会在10月12日到16日之间打电话，大概15分钟。想请居委会的陈主任，这三年社区义卖都是我牵头组织的，两万多元善款的账目也是我管，每次都按时公示，她都看在眼里。
reply: 陈主任您好，我是赵敏。我在应聘社区服务中心的项目助理，需要一位推荐人，想请您帮这个忙。对方会在10月12日到16日之间给您打个电话，大概15分钟。如果方便，最希望您能讲讲这三年社区义卖是我牵头组织的，还有两万多元善款的账目由我管、每次都按时公示。您那几天要是不方便，完全没关系，跟我说一声就行。
note: 离开职场多年时，社区和志愿经历里能核实的具体事一样是好的推荐点；时间和要讲的内容第一条就说清。

situation: I'm Maya, a support agent for two years. I've applied for an internal QA analyst role on the product team, and the hiring manager, Ben, wants to speak to my current manager, Joanne, by Friday Oct 9. Joanne doesn't know I applied yet. I wrote our 40 saved-reply templates and I log most of the bugs support sends to product, 31 this quarter.
reply: Hi Joanne, I wanted you to hear this from me first: I've applied for the internal QA analyst role on the product team. Ben would like to speak to you by Friday 9 October, and I'd be grateful if you'd be my reference. If it helps, the most relevant things for QA are the 40 saved-reply templates I wrote and the bugs I log for product, 31 this quarter. If you'd like to talk it through first, I'm free any time this week. Thanks, Maya
note: For an internal move, your manager hears it from you before the hiring manager calls; the reference ask comes second.

situation: I'm Leah. My old manager Grace has already been a reference for me twice this year, for Fenmore in March and Tallis in June; I didn't get either job and never told her how they ended. Now I'm in the final round for an operations manager role at Brookline Health, and they'll call references between Monday 12 and Friday 16 October. I'd like her to mention the 2024 warehouse consolidation I led and the 15% cut in overtime; my old colleague Tom could also do it if she'd rather not.
reply: Hi Grace, I owe you an update first: neither Fenmore nor Tallis came through, and I should have told you sooner. Thank you for doing both. I'm now in the final round for an operations manager role at Brookline Health, and they'd like to call references between Monday 12 and Friday 16 October. I know this would be the third time this year, so please say no if it's one too many; I have someone else I can ask. If you're up for it, the things they care most about are the 2024 warehouse consolidation and the 15% cut in overtime. Thanks, Leah
note: A repeat ask starts by closing the old loops, then makes the no easier than usual because the favour has added up.

situation: We're adopting a retired greyhound from a rescue, Second Chance Greyhounds, and they need a vet reference by Friday 9 October; it's a five-question email form. Dr. Amara Singh at Elmfield Vets looked after our last dog, Pepper, for all 11 years until he died in March, including managing his arthritis, and he never missed a check-up or vaccination.
reply: Dear Dr. Singh, I hope you're well. We're adopting a retired greyhound from Second Chance Greyhounds, and they've asked for a vet reference by Friday 9 October. It's a short five-question email form. Since you looked after Pepper for all 11 years, you'd be our first choice. If it helps, the things they care most about are that Pepper never missed a check-up or vaccination, and how we managed his arthritis with you. Would you be willing to fill it in? If the timing doesn't work, no problem at all.
note: A reference doesn't have to come from work: ask the professional who saw exactly what's being checked, with the deadline in the first message.

situation: 我叫陈默，去年本科毕业，毕业设计是刘教授指导的，他已经答应给我写推荐信，同一封信可以用于所有学校。我申请美国6个博士项目，截止日期从12月1日到12月15日不等，每个学校会分别发邮件请他上传。简历和研究陈述都准备好了，想一次把信息给全，免得来回打扰他。
reply: 刘教授您好，非常感谢您答应为我写推荐信。为了不来回打扰您，我把信息整理在一起：这次一共申请6个博士项目，截止日期从12月1日到12月15日，我做了一张表，列出每个学校的项目名称、截止日期和上传方式，和简历、研究陈述一起附在这封邮件里。各学校的上传邮件会陆续发到您的邮箱，同一封推荐信都可以用。如果哪个学校的邮件没收到，告诉我一声，我来联系学校。
note: 多个截止日期一次给齐，做成一张表；不要每个学校单独发一次请求，也不要频繁催。
